# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 9 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 16 tokens; Borders and rings — 2 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 19 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 9 tokens; Radius — 7 tokens; Shadow — 5 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css */
color: var(--surface);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (9)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `surface` | #faf8ff | #121318 | Page background. |
| `surface-variant` | #e1e2ec | #44464f | Legacy variant surface; prefer the surface-container scale. |
| `surface-dim` | #dad9e0 | #121318 | Dimmed page ground behind modals. |
| `surface-bright` | #faf8ff | #38393f | Brightest surface tone. |
| `surface-container-lowest` | #ffffff | #0d0e13 | Elevated cards (with elevation-1). |
| `surface-container-low` | #f4f3fa | #1a1b21 | Section panels, nav rail ground. |
| `surface-container` | #eeedf4 | #1e1f25 | Default container: app bar, panels, list zebra. |
| `surface-container-high` | #e8e7ef | #282a2f | Dialogs, menus, filled cards. |
| `surface-container-highest` | #e2e2e9 | #33343a | Filled text fields, highest tonal step. |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css */
color: var(--primary);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (19)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `primary` | #3f5ca1 | #b1c5ff | Brand navy. Filled buttons, active nav item, selected tab indicator, focused field border, switches on, links, the logo mark. Text on it: on-primary. |
| `primary-container` | #dae2ff | #254487 | Soft navy tint: FAB, selected chips, highlighted rows. Text on it: on-primary-container. |
| `secondary` | #575f67 | #bfc8d0 | Slate. Secondary icons and text accents; rarely a fill. |
| `secondary-container` | #dbe4ed | #3f484f | The workhorse tonal fill: tonal buttons, filter chips, nav-rail active pill, segmented button selected, env badges, avatar backgrounds. |
| `tertiary` | #974812 | #ffb68f | Copper. The ONE action that starts work: Run, Deploy, Apply. At most one filled tertiary button per screen. Never in dialogs. |
| `tertiary-container` | #ffdbca | #773200 | 'Deploying…' chips, small copper FAB, the cursor in the logo. |
| `error` | #ba1a1a | #ffb4ab | Error role (MD3 default). Error outlines, ERR log level, destructive text buttons. |
| `error-container` | #ffdad6 | #93000a | 'down' health chips, error banners. |
| `inverse-surface` | #2f3036 | #e2e2e9 | Snackbar ground. |
| `inverse-on-surface` | #f1f0f7 | #2f3036 | Snackbar text. |
| `inverse-primary` | #b1c5ff | #3f5ca1 | Snackbar action text. |
| `scrim` | #000000 | #000000 | Modal scrim at 32% alpha. |
| `shadow` | #000000 | #000000 | Shadow colour for the elevation tokens. |
| `ai` | #006a6a | #80d5d4 | Teal, extended colour: AI-powered features only (suggestions, explain/generate, AI chips). Never chrome, navigation or non-AI buttons, so teal always means 'a model did this'. |
| `ai-container` | #9cf1f0 | #004f50 | AI suggestion cards and AI chips. |
| `success` | #296b2a | #91d888 | Healthy / passing. Status dots, INFO log level. |
| `success-container` | #acf4a2 | #0b5314 | 'healthy' chips. |
| `warning` | #795900 | #fcbc00 | Degraded / attention. WARN log level. |
| `warning-container` | #ffdea0 | #5c4300 | 'degraded' chips, warning banners. |

## Type

Use the named styles; no literal px.

### Use

```css
font: var(--text-display-large);            /* with tokens.css */
font-family: var(--font-brand);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display-large` | `.display-large`, `--text-display-large` | 57px / 64px | 700 | `brand` | Marketing heroes only. |
| `display-medium` | `.display-medium`, `--text-display-medium` | 45px / 52px | 700 | `brand` | Page titles on foundation pages. |
| `display-small` | `.display-small`, `--text-display-small` | 36px / 44px | 700 | `brand` | Large numbers, splash. |
| `headline-large` | `.headline-large`, `--text-headline-large` | 32px / 40px | 600 | `brand` | Screen titles. |
| `headline-medium` | `.headline-medium`, `--text-headline-medium` | 28px / 36px | 600 | `brand` | Section titles. |
| `headline-small` | `.headline-small`, `--text-headline-small` | 24px / 32px | 600 | `brand` | Dialog titles. |
| `title-large` | `.title-large`, `--text-title-large` | 22px / 28px | 500 | `brand` | Top app bar title. |
| `title-medium` | `.title-medium`, `--text-title-medium` | 16px / 24px | 600 | `brand` | Card and list-item titles. |
| `title-small` | `.title-small`, `--text-title-small` | 14px / 20px | 600 | `brand` | Dense list titles, tab labels. |
| `body-large` | `.body-large`, `--text-body-large` | 16px / 24px | 400 | `brand` | Text-field values, reading text. |
| `body-medium` | `.body-medium`, `--text-body-medium` | 14px / 20px | 400 | `brand` | Default UI text. |
| `body-small` | `.body-small`, `--text-body-small` | 12px / 16px | 400 | `brand` | Helper text, captions. |
| `label-large` | `.label-large`, `--text-label-large` | 14px / 20px | 600 | `brand` | Button labels. |
| `label-medium` | `.label-medium`, `--text-label-medium` | 12px / 16px | 600 | `brand` | Chips, badges, nav labels. |
| `label-small` | `.label-small`, `--text-label-small` | 11px / 16px | 500 | `plain` | Mono metadata: IDs, paths, timestamps, log levels. |
| `code` | `.code`, `--text-code` | 13px / 20px | 400 | `plain` | Terminal output, keys, URLs, connection strings. |

## Spacing

4 px grid. Component insets use 2–6; section rhythm uses 6–12.

### Use

```css
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (9)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `space-1` | 4px | Icon-to-label gaps, chip inner gaps. |
| `space-2` | 8px | Gap between chips and buttons in a row. |
| `space-3` | 12px | Dense list rows, text-button padding. |
| `space-4` | 16px | Field padding, card padding, grid gaps. |
| `space-5` | 20px | Panel padding. |
| `space-6` | 24px | Dialog padding, filled-button horizontal padding, section gaps. |
| `space-8` | 32px | Between page sections. |
| `space-12` | 48px | Page top/bottom, hero spacing. |
| `space-16` | 64px | Page side gutters at desktop. |

## Radius

Material 3 shape scale.

### Use

```css
/* var(--radius-none) */
```

### Tokens (7)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `radius-none` | 0px | Dividers, table cells. |
| `radius-xs` | 4px | Text fields, snackbars, badges. |
| `radius-sm` | 8px | Chips, small tiles. |
| `radius-md` | 12px | Cards, small FAB, panels. |
| `radius-lg` | 16px | FAB, large panels, the logo box corner (10/64 of the mark). |
| `radius-xl` | 28px | Dialogs, bottom sheets. |
| `radius-full` | 9999px | Buttons, switches, pills, avatars. |

## Shadow

Tonal surface containers first; shadows only where the MD3 spec asks.

### Use

```css
/* var(--elevation-1) */
```

### Tokens (5)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `elevation-1` | 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.30), 0 1px 3px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.15) | Elevated buttons and cards. |
| `elevation-2` | 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.30), 0 2px 6px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.15) | Menus, hovered elevated cards. |
| `elevation-3` | 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.30), 0 4px 8px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.15) | FAB, dialogs, snackbars. |
| `elevation-4` | 0 2px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.30), 0 6px 10px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.15) | Dragged items. |
| `elevation-5` | 0 4px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.30), 0 8px 12px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.15) | Rare; modal sheets over dark. |
